subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat direct-message threading be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` account setting, or should this behavior be folded into the existing threading/reply configuration instead?
rationale: The code change is small, but it adds a user-facing config surface overlapping existing reply/thread semantics and reopens a delivery path previously disabled for API failures.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` with full contract
options.body: Keep the new opt-in key, but require exported types, generated metadata/docs, upgrade proof, and live Google Chat evidence before merge.

options.title: Use existing threading config
options.body: Ask for a narrower patch that models DM threading through the existing reply/threading configuration instead of adding a separate Google Chat-only knob.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it until maintainers decide that DM-threaded Google Chat app-auth replies are a supported product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` with full contract
recommendation.body: Keep the new opt-in key, but require exported types, generated metadata/docs, upgrade proof, and live Google Chat evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the most likely maintainer-side decision owner from the available Google Chat thread-reply history and prior verification path.
